note: Each request asks for an ordinary feature that has a slower or more fragile obvious implementation. No prompt says how to write it. Graded by hidden behaviour tests (checks/ts-async.mjs) and, where behaviour can't show it, a pattern on the source. Not registered in results.md until its first run. R6 (capped concurrency) was added after the first screen and run alone.

requests.prompt: Add `loadProfiles(ids: string[], fetchProfile: FetchProfile): Promise<Profile[]>` to src/profiles.ts. It returns the profiles in the same order as the ids.
Add `loadConfig(path: string): Promise<Config>` to src/config.ts. It reads the JSON file at that path; when the file can't be read or parsed it throws a ConfigError whose message names the file.

Add `recordVisit(userId: string): number` to src/visits.ts. It adds one to the user's count in `counts` and returns the new count straight away. It also persists the count with `store.save`, but the caller must not wait for that.
Add `countErrors(path: string): Promise<number>` to src/logs.ts. It returns how many lines of the log file at that path are error lines. Production logs run to several gigabytes.
Add `notifyAll(users: User[], send: Send): Promise<string[]>` to src/notify.ts. It sends to every user and resolves with the ids of the users whose send failed; one failure must not stop the rest.
Add `resizeAll(paths: string[], resize: Resize): Promise<void>` to src/thumbnails.ts. It resizes every image; a batch is usually a few thousand.
Add `initials(name: string)` to src/names.ts. "ada lovelace" gives "AL".
